summary: Mobile (Expo web preview) TEAM + NOTIFICATIONS feature tested end-to-end as serkan/19071987. All acceptance criteria pass: 4-tab bottom bar (GÖREVLER/TAKIM/BİLDİRİM/PROFİL) with unread badge (20), TAKIM renders 3 member cards with progress % + Toplam/Tamam/Bekleyen/Gecikmiş stats + red overdue badge (emp1_test=13), BİLDİRİM renders 20 items with type icon+label / task title / relative time / unread dot, tap-to-read decrements badge (20→19), delete removes item (20→19 items), and 'Tümü' clears badge to 0 and hides itself.

react_native_issues.issue: React-Native-Web console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Comes from a library (likely react-native-safe-area-context or expo-router internals), not from the new Team/Notifications code. Non-blocking; noted for hygiene.

critical_code_review_comments: notifications.tsx uses useFocusEffect+load('silent') AND a separate useEffect(load('initial')) on mount. Both fire on first mount (mount + first focus) causing a redundant GET /api/notifications call. Not a bug but wasteful; consider skipping the useEffect initial load since useFocusEffect already runs on first focus.

team.tsx: no useFocusEffect — data won't auto-refresh when returning to the tab after changes elsewhere. Only initial mount + pull-to-refresh. Consider adding useFocusEffect if team stats need to reflect task edits made in other tabs.

notifications.tsx remove()/markRead()/markAll() catch blocks silently swallow errors ('/* keep optimistic */'). If backend actually fails, UI stays optimistic and user sees no feedback. Consider surfacing a toast on server error.
seed_data_creation: None (used existing preview data). NOTE: This run consumed serkan's real unread notifications — tapped 1, deleted 1, then 'Tümü' cleared the remaining 18. Badge is now 0; re-running the badge/mark-all/delete assertions will require regenerating unread notifications on the backend.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature is fully functional. If you re-test notification mutations, first regenerate unread notifications for serkan (backend seed or by adding new tasks that trigger overdue/due_soon detection). testIDs verified live in DOM: team-screen, team-member-card-<uid>, notifications-screen, notification-item-<id>, notification-delete-button-<id>, notifications-mark-all-button. Login lazy-bundle can take ~25s on first cold load — always use wait_for_selector rather than fixed sleeps.
